chunks: And in the narration of Abū Khadījah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
Every person is held in pledge by the fitrah, and every newborn is held in pledge by the ʿaqīqah.

key_terms.ٱلْعَقِيقَةِ: the ʿaqīqah sacrifice associated with a newborn
key_terms.ٱلْفِطْرَةِ: the innate natural disposition upon which one is created

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says a newborn is held in pledge by the ʿaqīqah?
ai.summary: This hadith links the human being to fitrah, the innate natural disposition upon which people are created, and links the newborn specifically to the rite of ʿaqīqah. It highlights the religious importance of acknowledging both the God-given nature of human creation and the family practice associated with welcoming a child.
